text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a key part of AI: computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning, a more advanced form, uses large artificial neural networks to recognise patterns. AI is already part of daily life. For example, it recommends films on streaming services, helps doctors detect diseases, powers voice assistants on phones, and improves navigation apps. AI is not magic—it is software that learns from information. As technology develops, AI will become even more common in our homes, schools, and workplaces.
